_comment: Porter MCP server for OpenCode. NOTE: OpenCode uses a top-level "mcp" key (NOT "mcpServers"). HOW TO APPLY: merge the mcp.porter block into ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json (global) or ./opencode.json (project). Replace {{PORTER_TOKEN}} with a real Porter access token. Ensure the porter package is importable (pip install -e <repo> or PYTHONPATH). UNVERIFIED: config key layout validated against OpenCode docs 2026-10-11; not tested against a live OpenCode install in this environment.
